gate_criteria.description: Vercel and Core serve the same staging actors with no overlapping economic authority; old client routes remain compatible
verified_points: Isolated Vercel API project configuration in apps/api/vercel.json (region iad1 adjacent to Neon aws-us-east-1 and Oracle IAD) with preview secret isolation in apps/api/config.js and full 65-route ownership manifest in docs/v5/ROUTE-MANIFEST.md confirming zero economic mutation routes in API.

Account, social, practice, and read APIs implemented in apps/api using api_runtime role with monotonic cloud save CAS revisions, privacy-aware profile views (public/friends/private/blocked), and cross-service data consistency between API and Game Core.

Service-authenticated Core gateway in packages/services/core-gateway.js and apps/api/routes/competitive.js with HMAC-SHA256 signing, 30s drift check, opKey idempotency, and strict database least privilege (API role cannot mutate economic tables).

Old-origin browser compatibility facade in apps/api/middleware/cors.js, csrf.js, and routes/compat.js supporting play.antimatterinnovations.com, cookie auth continuity, CSRF enforcement, genuinely read-only GETs, legacy profile shape, and zero SQLite writes.

Future website foundations established in apps/api/routes/well-known.js and packages/services/browser-harness.js with association files, legal endpoints, callback contracts, and browser harness authentication, strictly preserving zero new website UI invariant.

verification.command: env V5_PG_URL=postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:50709/postgres V5_PG_DISPOSABLE=1 V5_PG_REQUIRED=1 node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-concurrency=1 tests/v5-p11-vercel-config.test.js tests/v5-p11-account-social.test.js tests/v5-p11-core-gateway.test.js tests/v5-p11-browser-compat.test.js tests/v5-p11-website-foundations.test.js
